result.instructions: Tools for Knack, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Knack data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run knack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run knack_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run knack_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. knack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: knack_get_application
tools.title: Get application schema
tools.description: Fetch a Knack application's full schema/metadata — its objects (tables), fields, and scenes. Knack API: GET /applications/{app_id}. Returns the raw JSON as-is. app_id defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

appId.description: Optional Knack Application ID; defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

tools.name: knack_list_objects
tools.title: List objects (tables)
tools.description: List an application's objects (tables) as a compact array [{ key, name, fieldCount }]. Convenience over GET /applications/{app_id}. app_id defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

appId.description: Optional Knack Application ID; defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

tools.name: knack_list_fields
tools.title: List fields for an object
tools.description: List the fields of ONE object as [{ key, name, type, required }]. Fetches GET /applications/{app_id} and returns the fields of the object whose key === objectKey (e.g. "object_1"). app_id defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

appId.description: Optional Knack Application ID; defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

tools.name: knack_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List an object's records. Knack API: GET /objects/{object_key}/records. Returns the paged envelope { total_pages, current_page, total_records, records: [...] } as-is. Records carry both field_x (formatted) and field_x_raw (structured) values. Page with page / rows_per_page (max 1000), sort with sort_field / sort_order, and filter with the `filters` object.

sort_field.description: Field key to sort by, e.g. "field_25".

filters.description: Optional Knack filter object, JSON-stringified into the `filters` query param. Shape: { "match": "and"|"or", "rules": [{ "field": "field_1", "operator": "is", "value": "Acme" }] }. Common operators: contains, does not contain, is, is not, starts with, ends with, higher than, lower than, is blank, is not blank.

tools.name: knack_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Fetch a single record by id. Knack API: GET /objects/{object_key}/records/{record_id}. Returns the bare record (with both field_x and field_x_raw values).

recordId.description: The record id (a hex string returned by Knack).

tools.name: knack_request
tools.title: Raw Knack API GET
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Knack API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool (e.g. view-based reads). READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Path starts with a slash (e.g. "/objects/object_1/records"). Knack API: GET {path}.

path.description: API path starting with a slash, e.g. "/objects/object_1/records".

tools.name: knack_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: MUTATES Knack data — creates a new record in an object. Knack API: POST /objects/{object_key}/records. Provide `fields` as an object keyed by field key, e.g. { "field_1": "Acme", "field_2": 100 }. Auto Increment / Formula / Equation fields are read-only and cannot be set. Returns the created record.

fields.description: The record's field values keyed by field key, e.g. { "field_1": "Acme", "field_2": 100 }. Auto Increment / Formula / Equation fields are read-only and cannot be written.

tools.name: knack_update_record
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: MUTATES Knack data — updates a record. Knack API: PUT /objects/{object_key}/records/{record_id}. Provide `fields` as an object keyed by field key; only the included fields change, e.g. { "field_1": "Acme Inc" }. Auto Increment / Formula / Equation fields are read-only. Returns the updated record.

recordId.description: The record id (a hex string returned by Knack).

fields.description: The record's field values keyed by field key, e.g. { "field_1": "Acme", "field_2": 100 }. Auto Increment / Formula / Equation fields are read-only and cannot be written.

tools.name: knack_delete_record
tools.title: Delete a record
tools.description: MUTATES Knack data — permanently DELETES a record (irreversible). Knack API: DELETE /objects/{object_key}/records/{record_id}. Knack returns { delete: true } on success.

recordId.description: The record id (a hex string returned by Knack).
